Introduction

Base URL

https://myorg.cashctrl.com/api/v1
Widget

List widgets

Returns a list of widgets.

Parameters

dirdir
optional
TEXT

Sort direction. Possible values: ASC, DESC.

limitlimit
optional
NUMBER

The number of entries to retrieve. Defaults to 100.

startstart
optional
NUMBER

The starting entry.

Endpoint

GET /api/v1/widget/list.json
Widget

Create widget

Creates a new widget.

Parameters

namename
mandatory
TEXT
MAX:100

The widget name.

partsparts
optional
JSON

The parts.

This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

kindkind
mandatory
TEXT

The part kind. Possible values: BOLT, NUT.

qtyqty
optional
NUMBER

How many.

Endpoint

POST /api/v1/widget/create.json
